source_caption_text:
This album will forever be connected to that crazy chapter of history 🤒🔥

Gunna’s sophomore album WUNNA arrived on May 22, 2020, during the height of the COVID-19 pandemic. With much of the world stuck at home and dealing with uncertainty, the album offered listeners a welcome escape through its smooth production, relaxed atmosphere, and luxurious themes.

Produced in part by Wheezy, Turbo, and Taurus, WUNNA leaned into warm melodies, acoustic guitar, and Gunna’s effortless delivery. Songs like “Dollaz On My Head,” “Cooler Than a Bitch,” and the title track helped create a carefree sound that felt perfectly suited to long days spent at home.

The album went on to debut at No. 1 on the Billboard 200, becoming one of the defining rap releases of 2020. For many listeners, WUNNA remains closely tied to that unusual period in history and stands as a reminder of how music can provide an escape when life feels uncertain.
